description_en: Starts a conversation with a bot by specifying its Bot ID. This applies only to Chatbot (Legacy)
description_zh: 根据机器人唯一标识（机器人ID）与其进行会话，仅适用于智能对话机器人（旧版）
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot chat --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --utterance '今天天气怎么样？' --session-id 9c6ebdc6e66f46ecadab3434314f6959 --knowledge-id 30002406051 --sender-id custumer_123456 --sender-nick '用户123456' --intent-name '查天气意图' --perspective FZJBY3raWr --vendor-param phone_:123456789 --sand-box true --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Chat

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the chatbot instance. To get this ID, log in to the Alibaba Cloud Chatbot console and go to Chatbot Details > Session API
parameters.help_zh: 机器人唯一标识（机器人ID）。登录云小蜜控制台，机器人详情->会话接口，查看机器人实例信息，可获得该实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID, used to identify a user session and maintain context. For a new user, omit this parameter in the first call to the `Chat` API. The chatbot automatically starts a session and returns the `SessionId` in the response. To continue the conversation, include this `SessionId` in all subsequent requests. The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话。长度限制是64个字符
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of an entry in the knowledge base. If you specify this ID, the chatbot directly returns the corresponding answer
parameters.help_zh: 知识库中知识标题的ID。若指定此ID，那么机器人会直接返回指定知识标题的答案
parameters.name: knowledge_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the user in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 访问者ID。用于识别当前会话中的用户
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the user in the current session
parameters.help_zh: 当前会话中访问的昵称
parameters.name: sender_nick

parameters.help_en: The name of an intent within a dialog flow. If specified, the chatbot directly activates this intent to process the user's request
parameters.help_zh: 对话流中意图名称。 若指定此名称，机器人会直接进入此意图做问答
parameters.name: intent_name

parameters.help_en: An array of perspective codes. Use these codes to retrieve answers from different perspectives for the same knowledge entry. Example: `Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]`. When using an SDK, refer to its parameter definitions
parameters.help_zh: 视角编码数组，用于调用同一知识标题下不同视角的答案。如：Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]。使用SDK时以SDK中定义的参数为准
parameters.name: perspective

parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted string containing custom parameters to pass to various dialog engines
parameters.help_zh: 是一个JSON格式的用户自定义参数集，可以传入用户自定义的参数到各对话引擎
parameters.name: vendor_param

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the environment to use. The default value is `false`, which indicates the production environment.

`true`: The test environment. This environment is for testing only. Do not use it in production due to potential instability and QPS limitations.

`false`: The production environment
parameters.help_zh:
测试、正式环境标识，默认为正式环境。
true：测试环境，仅限测试使用，生产使用有不稳定、QPS限制等风险。
false：正式环境
parameters.name: sand_box

parameters.help_en: The key for the business space. If omitted, the request is routed to the default business space. You can get this key from the Business Management page of your main account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key
